title: Monthly Interest Accrual on Summit Loans — Loan Accounting Note
content:
Interest on a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan accrues monthly at one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the month and is posted on the plan's interest posting day of the following month, rounded half up to the cent. No mortgage insurance and no servicing fee is charged on a Summit loan. Summit interest accrues only while the loan status is active, draw period expired or due and payable.

## The quantity

The month's interest is the Summit balance standing at the end of that month, multiplied by the note rate in percent, divided by 1200 (that is, one twelfth of the annual rate expressed as a fraction), with the result rounded half up to the cent. The note rate used is the note rate on the loan record; the balance is the loan's outstanding Summit balance — amounts advanced plus accrued interest, less repayments. The amount is posted to the balance on the posting day of the following month.

## When interest accrues

| Loan status | Interest accrues |
|---|---|
| Active | yes |
| Draw period expired | yes |
| Due and payable | yes |
| In its rescission period | no |
| Rescinded | no |
| Paid in full | no |
| Liquidated | no |

The three accruing statuses are the complete list; in every other status no Summit interest accrues. The status is the one shown on the loan record.

## Worked figures (hypothetical balances and rates)

| Hypothetical month-end balance | Hypothetical note rate | Unrounded month's interest | Posted interest |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 276413.90 | 7.125% | USD 1641.20753 | USD 1641.21 |
| USD 405118.44 | 6.500% | USD 2194.39155 | USD 2194.39 |

In the first line the third decimal place is 7, so the cent rounds up; in the second it is 1, so the cent stays.

## Points of judgement

- **Is a monthly fee added to the interest?** No. A Summit loan bears no mortgage insurance and no servicing fee, so the month's interest is the only accrual described here.
- **Which balance is used — the balance at the start of the month or at its end?** The balance at the end of the month for which interest is accrued.
- **When does the borrower see the month's interest?** On the posting day of the following month.
